run_googletest_throw_on_failure_test: run the googletest throw-on-failure test suite with gtest_test_utils to verify exit codes
test_throw_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable by setting it to 0 or 1 and verifying exit behavior
test_throw_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_throw_on_failure CLI flag by passing 0 or 1 and verifying exit behavior
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_throw_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable
set_env_var_utility: use SetEnvVar to set or unset an environment variable by passing its name and value or None
